tools.name: lampway_apply_part_fixes
tools.description: Apply an auditor's part fixes (island or bbox relabels) to a transferred owner map; writes a new map. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_asset_acceptance
tools.description: Workflow, engine acceptance: identity / orientation / geometry / materials gates for a candidate asset (optionally against a `reference` object), each with reasons, and an overall `accepted`. Lists what it did not check.

params.name: reference
params.desc: An approved object to compare bounds against

params.name: tolerance
params.desc: Fraction of the reference diagonal, default 0.1

params.name: source_hash
params.desc: sha256 of the approved source: identity fails unless the object records it (mesh_prep does) or is identical to it

tools.name: lampway_auto_rig
tools.description: Auto Rig: a UE-named humanoid armature `<object>_rig` placed from landmarks measured on a T-pose mesh (standing on Z, facing -Y by default; _l/_r are the FIGURE's own sides), the mesh parented with heat-map weights and a proximity fallback for vertices heat cannot solve. Test it with lampway_pose_test: a rig is not a claim of deformation quality. engine=studio:tripo is the Auto Rig slot (answers with action and price). Body plans beyond the humanoid, each from landmarks measured on the mesh standing on Z: quadruped | hexapod | octopod (feet clustered per side; upper, lower and foot per leg; spine, head, tail), avian (the humanoid with wing_* arms), serpentine | aquatic (a chain of chain_bones along the principal axis), auto (inferred, reported as kind_inferred). naming ue (default) | mixamo (mixamorig:*) | metahuman (the UE5 names; spine_04/05 and neck_02 are not made), humanoid and avian only; tripo is refused (its naming is not documented here). parts: more mesh objects rigged as ONE character with one armature.

params.name: kind
params.desc: humanoid (default) | quadruped | hexapod | octopod | avian | serpentine | aquatic | auto

params.name: parts
params.desc: more mesh objects of the same character

params.name: engine
params.desc: algorithmic (default) | studio:tripo; or one of the purpose's options (local:heat_map, local:proximity); omit it to use the user's choice in Choices

params.name: copy
params.desc: Rig a copy `<object>_rigged` and leave the source untouched (default true); false rigs in place

tools.name: lampway_delete_caps
tools.description: Delete a cap that closes an opening that must stay open (neck bowl, waist fan, arm dome) by ray-casting through a rectangular footprint; UVs kept; writes a NEW file. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: beyond
params.desc: threshold coordinate: the cap is the first hit beyond it

params.name: grow
params.desc: rings of neighbouring polygons also deleted

tools.name: lampway_detail_normals
tools.description: Micro depth for a textured_atlas material without the relief map: per-material tiling detail normals box-projected in object space (metals take their ambientCG NormalGL maps; cloth and leather a small bump from their colour), blended by the material's per-texel masks. Idempotent: its 'DN:' nodes are replaced on a re-run. strengths: {plate, gold, cloth, leather}.

params.name: strengths
params.desc: Per-layer strengths, defaults plate 0.6, gold 0.45, cloth 0.25, leather 0.3

params.name: ambientcg_dir
params.desc: The ambientCG folder (default: the settings / LAMPWAY_AMBIENTCG_DIR)

tools.name: lampway_export_parts
tools.description: Parts Library publishing: export a finished part set as candidates, one GLB plus part.json per part under <out_dir>/Parts Library/Candidates/<item>/<source stem>/<part>/v####/ and SET.<set_version>.json. part.json records the source mesh and its sha256, the face ids into it, the recipe lineage and stages, motion class, bind, scale stage, the held notes for that part and the GLB sha256. Geometry is the source's own faces (positions, UVs untouched). Versions never overwrite: an unchanged part keeps its version, any change (faces, class, bind, notes, lineage, corners or UVs) writes the next v####; an existing SET version is refused. Recipe: {smartmesh, parts: {name: {class, bind, from?}}, held: [{note, parts}], stages?, repair?, scale_stage?}; owner.npy is one part index per face (-1 none). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_export_piece
tools.description: Export a finished piece for the engine: the object as FBX into out_dir, its texture maps copied under Textures/, and a README naming every file, what each map is (ORM order, normal convention) and its sha256. The scene is not changed. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: textures
params.desc: The maps to ship (e.g. the pbr_merge outputs)

tools.name: lampway_gen_parts_table
tools.description: Write a part set's table (part, version, faces, motion class, bind, held-note titles) and its held notes into a library-wiki entity spec FROM the exported files (SET.<v>.json and each part.json), never by hand; the table names the SET file and its sha256. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_image_to_3d
tools.description: Image to 3D / multi-view WITHOUT a model: mode hull = the visual hull of two or more cardinal views (images = {"Front": path, "Left": path, ...}; Front u=+X, Left u=-Y; silhouettes from alpha or the corner colour), extrude = a rounded or slab extrusion of Front (+Back) for paired pieces (depth in metres), relief = a luminance relief of one image. The mesh is judged by re-projection IoU, volume and boundary edges. engine=studio:tripo is the Smart Mesh slot (100 credits): it answers with action and price for the owner's approval and clicks nothing. A turnaround SHEET is cut first: detect_views=<sheet> with views = the panel order left to right (never guessed) splits it into labelled views (a single image wider than 2:1 is refused: it would fuse the panels). paired=true (gauntlets, boots) takes front and back only. engine studio:tripo (tripo.mesh) | studio:meshy (meshy.multi_image_to_3d) | studio:hi3d (hi3d.image_to_3d) answer with the action and its plan_args for studio_plan after a plate check (a plate under 1024 px, without a subject or touching the border is named: fix the plate first; plate_check=false skips it). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: images
params.desc: View name -> image path (project-relative); or detect_views

params.name: engine
params.desc: algorithmic (default) | studio:tripo | studio:meshy | studio:hi3d; or one of the purpose's options (local:visual_hull, local:extrude, local:relief, studio:tripo.mesh, studio:meshy.image_to_3d, studio:hi3d.image_to_3d, studio:hyper3d.generate, studio:hyper3d.mcp.generate, studio:tripo.rest.image_to_model); omit it to use the user's choice in Choices

params.name: detect_views
params.desc: a turnaround sheet to cut into views

params.name: views
params.desc: detect_views: the panel order left to right, e.g. Front, Left, Back, Right

params.name: plate_check
params.desc: studio engines: check the plates first, default true

tools.name: lampway_index_delta
tools.description: A texture library's next INDEX as a delta: every file in the current listing the baseline listing lacked or holds with another sha256, and every removed path, with sha256 and size; the wiki layer excluded. The out file name carries the version (INDEX.v####.json) and is never overwritten. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: baseline
params.desc: the listing taken right after the previous INDEX was uploaded

tools.name: lampway_judge_pack
tools.description: The review pack for a parts regroup: two face labellings of one mesh (vote_a, vote_b: integer face attributes, e.g. two segmenters) reconciled into candidates and decisions: agreed (face IoU >= 0.8), split (A cut by B into >= 2 pieces of >= 10 %), merge (B spanning >= 2 A parts), standalone. Writes pack.json, masks/, candidate sheets (isolated and in context) and one sheet per decision (option A over option B). The decisions are the user's. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_libwiki
tools.description: Publish a library inventory as an LLM wiki, deterministically. command build: spec.json + an `rclone lsjson -R --hash` inventory + authored pages (SCHEMA.md, concepts/, comparisons/, queries/) -> out: raw pointer pages pinning every file's sha256, one generated page per spec entity, index.md and an append-only log.md (pages added, removed, changed); refuses a bad spec by name, never replaces a directory that is not its wiki, keeps the previous wiki on failure. lint: frontmatter, links, tags, totals, pointer hashes, log format. drift: what changed in a new inventory. Generated pages are never hand-edited: change the spec or the authored page and rebuild. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: paths
params.desc: build: spec, inventory, authored dir, out; lint: out; drift: out, new inventory

tools.name: lampway_mesh_compare
tools.description: Compare candidate meshes with a reference: faces, open boundary loops, shells, matcap renders. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_mesh_prep
tools.description: Workflow, geometry preparation: a branch `<object>_prep` of a generated mesh with its source hash recorded, loose and doubled vertices removed and inverted normals fixed; returns before/after reports. The source is untouched.

tools.name: lampway_mesh_to_npz
tools.description: Export a mesh (fbx/glb) or the MetaHuman body (with joints) to npz for the proportion tools. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_pauldron_symmetry
tools.description: Is one pauldron sunken? Height maps of each shoulder against the mirrored other. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_pbr_merge
tools.description: The engine-ready PBR set (BaseColor sRGB, Normal GL and DX, ORM = occlusion/roughness/metallic, Roughness, Metallic) for a patched mesh from a studio PBR set plus our projection: the studio texels are kept, the patch islands are filled from our albedo atlas and the class medians, the live palette is baked in linear space, metal is forced to 0 on non-metal classes. Writes merge.json beside the maps. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: masks
params.desc: Directory with mask_*.png and texel_face.npy (the projection's)

params.name: params
params.desc: live_material_params.json (palette per mask, metal_zero_on, normal strength)

tools.name: lampway_piece_ratios
tools.description: Proportion scores of the NON-torso pieces (kind helmet | waist | boots | gauntlets) against the MetaHuman body: scale-free landmark ratios, piece vs body + a uniform wear clearance, score = RMS log deviation (0 = the body's proportions). The torso (chest) is lampway_proportion_ratios. NEW and UNVALIDATED (`validated: false` until an auditor's falsification is recorded): it ranks, it does not decide. Known biases: helmet depth includes a crest, the waist scores the design flare, boots score knee height and relief, gauntlets cannot see collapsed or slotted plates. A gauntlet that is not cuff-up is refused. body.npz needs joints (mesh_to_npz body). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_place_piece
tools.description: Place a torso piece on the body the way the audits do (chest width + 40 mm, axilla aligned). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_pose_clearance
tools.description: The MetaHuman's closest pose to a placed piece (arms, hips, chest, neck) and the residual blocking surfaces. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_proportion_ratios
tools.description: The PRIMARY proportion score of torso pieces against the MetaHuman body: scale-free landmark ratios (lower is closer; 0 = the body's proportions). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_render_final
tools.description: Render a finished part set for review (Workbench, orthographic, deterministic, the wearer's axes): the assembly with every part its own colour, the unassigned faces in magenta, and per part an isolated front/back/left/right sheet and a context sheet. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_render_owner
tools.description: Render a mesh coloured by its part owner map: four orthographic views plus a legend; flagged polygons in magenta. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_render_video
tools.description: Video: render a turntable or a keyframed camera path (waypoints [{frame, location}]) of an object to an H.264 mp4 under the project root, in a throw-away scene, with the light engines only (workbench | eevee; Cycles is refused). The file is read back (frames, size, bytes). engine=model:<name> is the generative video slot: not wired. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: out
params.desc: mp4 path under the project root

tools.name: lampway_retopo
tools.description: Retopology: a NEW all-quad mesh `<object>_retopo` near target_faces (QuadriFlow; voxel remesh as the fallback) with a measured report (faces, quads, non-manifold and open-boundary edges, surface deviation). The original is untouched; keep it until the replacement passes your checks. engine=studio:tripo answers with the studio action and its price for the owner's approval and clicks nothing. method=autoremesher runs the Qt-free lampway-quadremesh configured by the settings key autoremesher_bin (never an argument), niced with a timeout; the result has no UV layer.

params.name: engine
params.desc: algorithmic (default) | studio:tripo; or one of the purpose's options (local:quadriflow, local:voxel, local:autoremesher, studio:meshy.remesh, studio:tripo.rest.decimate); omit it to use the user's choice in Choices

params.name: fallback
params.desc: quadriflow / autoremesher: use the voxel remesh when the engine fails or leaves the mesh unchanged (else refused)

params.name: preserve_sharp
params.desc: quadriflow: keep sharp (hard-surface) edges, default true

params.name: per_part
params.desc: quadriflow: remesh each part alone (boundary kept, welded back): no face spans two parts

params.name: part_attribute
params.desc: the INT face attribute holding the parts, default part

tools.name: lampway_segment_mesh
tools.description: Mesh Segment: split a mesh into part objects in the collection `<object>_parts` (largest first, UVs and materials kept). method: shells (connected pieces) | sharp (regions bounded by edges sharper than `angle` degrees) | uv_islands (needs a UV layer). Regions smaller than min_faces merge into the neighbour they share the longest border with. The original is hidden, never deleted. engine=studio:tripo is the part-detection slot (answers with action and price). labels instead NAMES the UV islands as vertex groups <object>_<label> (nothing is split), with the Client's own island enumeration (Mesh Segment's island_labels): mode map takes island_labels {"<island>": label}; mode recipe gives each island the recipe part owning the majority of its faces in owner (a .npy per polygon, default the int face attribute 'part'), an island under min_share (0.6) unlabelled and named; labels outside the recipe's part names are refused, and more than max_unlabeled (0.3) of the faces unlabelled refuses to apply. Needs a UV map.

params.name: min_faces
params.desc: Merge regions under this many faces, default 1 (no merge)

params.name: engine
params.desc: algorithmic (default) | studio:tripo; or one of the purpose's options (local:shells, local:sharp, local:uv_islands, local:transfer_parts, studio:hyper3d.bang, studio:hyper3d.mcp.generate_bang, studio:hi3d.split); omit it to use the user's choice in Choices

params.name: labels
params.desc: {mode: map | recipe, island_labels: {island: label}, recipe: parts json, owner: .npy, min_share, max_unlabeled}

tools.name: lampway_split_relief
tools.description: Split a raised relief (the pauldron lion heads) out of its part as a material-only part, by the part's dense Smart UV islands. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_transfer_parts
tools.description: Carry an APPROVED part set onto a new seed of the same design (body-frame nearest label, then a Smart UV island vote; weak islands are flagged, never silently relabelled). Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

tools.name: lampway_uv_unwrap
tools.description: UV unwrap: a NEW mesh `<object>_uv` with a packed layout (method smart | angle | conformal; seams at edges sharper than angle_limit) and a measured report (islands, coverage, overlap by rasterising, texel-density spread, the density achieved at texture_size). The original keeps its UVs; inspect the checker before texturing. engine=studio:tripo is the Smart UV slot: it answers with the action and price for the owner's approval.

params.name: margin
params.desc: Island margin in UV units, default 0.005

params.name: engine
params.desc: algorithmic (default) | studio:tripo; or one of the purpose's options (local:smart, local:angle, local:conformal, studio:tripo.uv.unwrap, studio:meshy.uv_unwrap); omit it to use the user's choice in Choices

tools.name: lampway_verify_set
tools.description: Independent check of an exported part set, no Blender: every part GLB named by SET.<v>.json is re-read with a minimal glTF reader and must equal the faces of the source GLB its face_ids name corner by corner (positions, UVs, winding); triangle counts, sha256 and node names must match part.json; every source face is covered exactly once; evidence paths carry the set version and resolve. Writes <set dir>/evidence/VERIFY.<v>.json (never overwritten); exit 1 on any failure. Paths are relative to the project root; a path outside it is refused.

params.name: original
params.desc: the original GLB, to compare the repaired mesh's first faces with
